input_snapshot.goal: An autonomous trading research factory that continuously converts raw ideas into scored evidence across crypto, forex, and prediction markets.

plan.title: Test shorter hold_bars (96-120) for adaptive multi-timeframe signals
plan.objective: Explore shorter hold_bars (96-120) for more adaptive signals to improve robustness compared to prior run with hold_bars=168 which showed 48% OOS Sharpe degradation
plan.hypothesis: Shorter hold_bars (96-120) will produce more adaptive signals that maintain OOS Sharpe better across windows, addressing the hold_bars instability (CV=0.43-0.54) observed in prior runs
plan.strategy_rationale: Prior multi-timeframe experiments (EXP-20260404133920-01, EXP-20260331154332-55) showed hold_bars as the most unstable parameter (CV=0.43-0.54) while core parameters remained stable. Shorter hold_bars may capture more regime transitions and reduce overfitting to extended trends.
dataset_requirements: BNB/USDT 1h OHLCV with multi-year history (2021-04 to 2026-04)

historical_depth_requirement.justification: Deep crypto dataset available from prior runs; multi-year history required for robust WFA with 54+ windows

source_plan.selection_reason: BNB/USDT deep dataset already exists in workspace/data/binance_bnbusdt_1h_deep.csv with 43788 rows

plan.scope_selection_rationale: BNB/USDT selected as it was used in prior run (RUN-20260404211002-hmi9jy) allowing direct comparison; shorter hold_bars hypothesis builds on prior finding that hold_bars showed CV=0.43-0.54 instability

data_acquisition.reason: BNB/USDT deep dataset already present from prior run

implementation_steps: 1. Create parameter space with hold_bars range 96-120 (vs prior 168)
2. Run WFA with Optuna optimization over 54+ walk-forward windows
3. Compare OOS Sharpe, positive window rate, and parameter stability to prior run
4. Evaluate if shorter hold_bars improves robustness metrics

evaluation_criteria.status_gate: Must achieve higher OOS Sharpe and/or >70% positive Sharpe windows vs prior run (0.664 OOS, 61.1% windows)

fallback_if_blocked: If WFA fails, use workspace/harness/wfa_minimal.py as fallback for quick signal validation
notes: Critical: This is a direct follow-up to RUN-20260404211002-hmi9jy which showed hold_bars=168 had 48% OOS Sharpe degradation
Key metric to beat: prior OOS Sharpe 0.664, prior positive windows 61.1%
Hypothesis: shorter hold_bars (96-120) may generalize better by capturing more regime changes

relevant_execution_lessons.lesson: Planner must verify strategy directories exist before referencing them in execution commands
relevant_execution_lessons.specific_finding: Plan created execution command pointing to non-existent strategies/ema_trend_gate_eth/wfa_config.yaml, blocking experiment before WFA could run

relevant_execution_lessons.lesson: Config path validation is missing from planner workflow - recurring blocker pattern
relevant_execution_lessons.specific_finding: Multiple prior experiments blocked due to non-existent config paths; this indicates systematic gap where planners do not verify strategy directories exist before execution

known_blocker_patterns.lesson: volatility_regime.py on BTC produces too few trades (22 vs 200 required) - volatility expansion events are rare, strategy enters only on regime change from contraction to expansion
Data range mismatch persists across experiments - BTC shows 2021-start gap similar to prior ETH
